messages:
Ava (FinOps): Noticed ~63 invoices in today's run where usage for the day looks doubled. Appears in reconciliation as duplicate meter lines (same usage_id, two entries). Opening here before we touch NS exports.

Leo (Data Eng): Interesting. Any correlation by region/timezone? Could be job window overlap.

Ava (FinOps): Clustered around 2026-04-11T00:00-01:00 UTC. Many are EU customers. Example invoice inv_06Qa7R2S for cus_EU_12. SQL snippet:
```sql
SELECT u.usage_id, count(*) cnt, min(created_at), max(created_at)
FROM usage_events u
WHERE u.created_at between '2026-04-11T00:00:00Z' and '2026-04-11T01:00:00Z'
AND u.invoice_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY u.usage_id
HAVING cnt > 1;
```
Returned 63 rows.

analytics-bot: Alert: usage.duplicate_events spike=63 window=2026-04-11T00:00Z-2026-04-11T01:00Z. Job id=hourly-agg-2026-04-11-00.

Priya (Billing Ops): I've paused the NetSuite export for the midnight hourly batch. Please don't run manual adjustments until we confirm root cause.

Leo (Data Eng): Quick theory: hourly-aggregator cron moved from UTC to local timezone after infra change to the runner hosts; during DST flip we had an overlapping window so events were aggregated twice. The aggregator uses event_time_floor(window) but the window calculation relied on host local time. I'll check deployment changes.

Ava (FinOps): That fits; many affected customer locales are CET which had DST change last week. If aggregator double-counted, we must backfill corrected invoice lines and re-export.

Leo (Data Eng): Reproducer log: 
```
2026-04-11T00:00:01+01:00 INFO hourly-agg start window=2026-04-11T00:00+01:00 host=agg-02
2026-04-11T00:00:02Z INFO hourly-agg start window=2026-04-11T00:00Z host=agg-01
2026-04-11T00:05:12Z WARN hourly-agg duplicate-detected usage_id=u_9f3a
```
We had two aggregator workers with different timezone interpretations.

Priya (Billing Ops): For remediation: (1) pause NS export (done), (2) run de-dup backfill to remove repeated usage lines from invoices and recompute checksums, (3) re-run export with validation to fail if invoice lines change after export. I can own 2 and 3 if you provide affected invoice list.

Leo (Data Eng): I'll produce the list and a safe backfill script that dedupes by usage_id per invoice_id and recomputes totals. Command (dry-run first):
```bash
./bin/agg-backfill --since 2026-04-11T00:00:00Z --to 2026-04-11T01:00:00Z --dedupe-by usage_id --dry-run --out gs://redwood-finance/backfills/2026-04-11-hourly-dedupe-dryrun.csv
```
I'll include checksums before/after so you can validate.

Ava (FinOps): Please add an invariant check to fail the NetSuite export if any invoice checksum changed since the export started. Also add alert usage.aggregator.timezone-mismatch.

analytics-bot: Incident INC-2026-3608 created: assignee=Leo (Data Eng), severity=medium.

Priya (Billing Ops): I'll await dry-run. If dry-run looks clean, we'll run the live backfill and then re-run export. Notifying AR to expect possible re-posts for affected invoices.

Leo (Data Eng): Found deployment change: cron container image updated 2026-04-10 23:50 UTC and the new image sets TZ=Europe/Berlin while older workers used UTC. Rolling back to image that uses TZ=UTC and adding explicit windowing by UTC in code. Patch PR analytics/hourly-agg#512.

Ava (FinOps): Thanks. Owners: Leo - fix aggregator + backfill; Priya - hold export, run re-export and validation; Ava - coordinate accounting & CS if customers see invoice PDFs changed. ETA for cleanup: 3-4 hours after dry-run.

Priya (Billing Ops): Dry-run output stored at gs://redwood-finance/backfills/2026-04-11-hourly-dedupe-dryrun.csv. Looks like 63 invoices would change. Proceeding to schedule live backfill in 30m.

Leo (Data Eng): Backfill executed and live run removed duplicate lines. Recompute logs: 
```
2026-04-11T01:15:22Z INFO backfill completed rows_modified=63 dry_run=false
```
Deployed aggregator fix and added unit tests for UTC windowing.

Priya (Billing Ops): Re-exported cleaned invoices and re-ran NetSuite import. No further duplicates. AR verified revenue totals unchanged after dedupe. Marking ledger entries as corrected and adding notes.

Ava (FinOps): Great work. Please add this incident to the finance retro and include the rollout checklist item: always run aggregator with UTC windows and never rely on host TZ.
